thread:
sarah: FYI customer ACME (acct acme-inc) opened a ticket — invoice total ≠ dashboard total for Feb. They see ~€0.37 difference on a €1423.18 invoice. Dashboard token sum and invoice line-items don't match.

marta: ouch. is this the per-request small-charges problem again? :thinking:

sarah: looks like it. they have ~9,600 micro-requests (lots of short chat turns). Each request generates tiny token charges (0.0007€–0.0041€). If billing rounds per-line to cents, cumulative rounding could be ~€0.3–0.5.

james: can you upload a redacted snippet of the usage file and the invoice lines? I want to confirm whether rounding happens before or after aggregation.

sarah: uploaded sample csv to the ticket (redacted) — showing 12 rows that reproduce the delta. Quick paste:

```:request_id, tokens, price_per_token_eur, raw_charge_eur
r1,3,0.0008,0.0024
r2,2,0.0008,0.0016
r3,5,0.0008,0.0040
...
sum_raw=0.0080
sum_billed=0.01
```

sarah: invoice shows per-line cents rounded, billing dashboard shows aggregated then rounded. So invoice = sum(rounded_per_request) while dashboard = round(sum(raw)).

ana: pipeline note: the ledger ingestor currently emits per-request line_items with charge rounded to 2 decimals for the invoice generator. Dashboard uses the unrounded accumulator then formats.

james: confirmed. that's a bug — we should be consistent. Two options:
- change invoices to aggregate unrounded then round once (preferred),
- or change dashboard to show the per-line rounded total (less ideal).

liam: what customer-facing outcome do we want? If we switch invoice calc we'll need to backfill corrections for recent month if delta > threshold.

marta: customer wants an explanation + possible credit. They flagged this as P2 escalate.

james: I'll run a replay job to recompute Feb invoices using aggregate-then-round. Need go-ahead for corrections if diff > €1. Will post results here.

sarah: repro steps I used:
1) export usage for acct acme-inc from 2026-02-01..2026-02-28 (CSV)
2) compute per-request charge = tokens * price_per_token
3) sum_raw = sum(per-request charge)
4) sum_rounded_lines = sum(round(per-request charge,2))
5) compare sum_raw rounded vs sum_rounded_lines

curl example to fetch a sample request:
```:curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=acme-inc&limit=100"
```

ana: can you paste 5 request_ids we can grep from logs? we need full logs to confirm any other rounding steps in transformation.

sarah: paste: r1, r2, r3, r14, r42

billing-bot: invoice_recalc_job started for acct=acme-inc month=2026-02 (job_id=inv-recalc-20260310-88)

james: job finished. recompute summary:
- original_invoice_total: €1423.18
- dashboard_total (aggregate-then-round): €1422.81
- invoice_per-line_total: €1423.18
- delta = +€0.37 (invoice higher)

james: proposal: issue credit of €0.37 or update invoice to new total and notify acct. Need approvals from finance.

marta: will loop in finance and CS for approval. Please attach job logs and SQL used for recompute.

liam: also add a product ticket (billing consistency) — this affects trust. Recommend we change invoice calc to aggregate-then-round and add a flag to keep legacy behavior for one-off backfills.

sarah: customer-facing note drafted: short explanation + offer credit for the delta pending finance approval.

marta: thanks. follow-ups: (1) james to run automated sanity check across customers (2) ana to open infra PR to ensure invoice generator consumes unrounded accumulator (3) liam to own product ticket and prioritization.

james: starting sanity scan across all invoices for Feb (threshold €0.10). Will post a summary when done.

sarah: thanks team — keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
